name: antigravity-activity-dashboard
description: Futuristic mission control dashboard and agent cockpit for Antigravity IDE, displaying local projects, active sessions, Graphify maps, and live AI model quotas on startup.
author: Antigravity Open Source Community

antigravity.dashboard.openOnStartup.description: Automatically open the Antigravity Cockpit dashboard whenever Antigravity IDE launches.

antigravity.dashboard.language.description: Antigravity Cockpit interface language (auto: System / IDE language, en: English, tr: Turkish, de: German, es: Spanish, fr: French, zh: Simplified Chinese, ja: Japanese).

antigravity.dashboard.githubUser.description: GitHub username to list repositories for (auto-detected via gh CLI if left empty).

antigravity.dashboard.scanRoots.description: Additional root directories to scan for local projects (e.g. ~/projects).

antigravity.dashboard.extraProjectPaths.description: Specific project directory paths to display directly on the dashboard.

antigravity.dashboard.browser.description: Preferred browser when opening Graphify visual maps and external links.

antigravity.dashboard.pollIntervalSec.description: Background interval (in seconds) for silently polling AI model quotas.

antigravity.dashboard.sessionLimit.description: Maximum number of recent chat sessions to display.

antigravity.dashboard.soundEnabled.description: Default state for futuristic cyber audio sound effects.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
